headline: dbt arrives and database storage drops by more than half

items.title: Reporting built by dbt
items.detail: All reporting models moved to dbt with tests, and the old shadow setup was removed.

items.title: Staging core on dbt
items.detail: Orders, items, products, customers and refunds rebuilt as tested dbt models. 67,815 unlinked marketplace lines fixed.

items.title: Raw JSON archived to S3
items.detail: Raw API payloads moved from the database to S3, cutting storage from 22.4 to 9.7 GB.

items.title: CI on every pipeline repo
items.detail: Tests run on Python 3.12 for every push.

items.title: Keyless Google Sheets access
items.detail: Pipelines read Google Sheets through workload identity, with no service-account keys.

items.title: Reference data from Google Sheets
items.detail: Freight, box and zone data sync from Sheets with versioned history.

items.title: Freight on volumetric weight
items.detail: Courier freight is priced on box volumetric weight.

items.title: Deadlocks fixed
items.detail: Unicommerce batch writes no longer deadlock each other.
